findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Module/RingHom.lean:57 `abbrev Module.compHom [Semiring S] (f : S →+* R) : Module S M` under `variable [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]`. The downstream target instance is also module-level: mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Binomial.lean:277 `noncomputable instance {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R] [Module ℚ≥0 R] [Pow R ℕ] : BinomialRing R`.
findings.fix: Weaken to `noncomputable def moduleNNRat {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] [Module ℚ A] : Module ℚ≥0 A := Module.compHom _ (algebraMap ℚ≥0 ℚ)`, and adjust the module doc/docstring wording from "rational algebra" to "ℚ-module". Both call sites (Kostant/Form.lean:69, UniversalEnveloping/Commutation.lean:80) are ℚ-algebras and get `Module ℚ` from `Algebra.toModule`, so they are unchanged.
findings.issue: `moduleNNRat` assumes `[Semiring A] [Algebra ℚ A]`, but the body uses those only to obtain `Module ℚ A`; restriction of scalars along `algebraMap ℚ≥0 ℚ` needs nothing more. A ℚ-vector space that is not an algebra cannot use this file, whose entire stated purpose is to be locally activated by consumers.

summary: The two prior generality findings are resolved at head (polynomial lemmas are now coefficient-generic; the left-hand binomial variant is derived, not re-proved). One over-assumption remains: the new `moduleNNRat` restriction-of-scalars def is stated for ℚ-algebras although its body only needs a ℚ-module.
